architecture: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Jinja2 + vanilla JS app. Items AND subitems are both ItemDB rows (parent_id self-ref FK, cascade delete). Material-3 dark "Terminus" theme with all --md-shape-*: 0px (sharp corners). SUBITEM_NAMES list in main.py (now ~line 520, one item per line, 6934 unique entries) feeds a <datalist id="subitem-names"> selector on the item form. Subitem submit protocol: parallel lists sub_id/sub_name/sub_qty/sub_is_parasite/sub_chance; authoritative hidden sub_is_parasite field synced by .sub-para-toggle checkbox to guarantee equal-length lists for zip in item_form_dep; kept ids on request.state.subitem_ids; ui_item_update upserts by id. Version bump rule: every code modification bumps APP_VERSION (alpha/beta tag by change size); session reached 1.7.12-alpha.

Root cause: FastAPI treats empty-string values of required Form(...) fields as 'missing' → 422 before the handler ran.
